entityDescription:
The core business of NCIM is staff augmentation with IT Specialists for system integration, support and staffing of projects in technological, scientific and military settings, often in highly secured domains The highly-qualified NCIM IT professionals are supporting clients with work on mission-critical programs. All of NCIM’s professional staff hold academic degrees ranging from BSc and MSc to PhD and have excellent IT skills. 
The majority of NCIM employees hold active Security Clearances at NATO/EU Secret or higher levels and work on classified, secure and challenging high technology projects.
Over the past 33 years NCIM has obtained an outstanding reputation in the Dutch Defence, NATO, Europol and Public Security Domain by making customer satisfaction its top priority. NCIM is characterized by entrepreneurship, innovation and agility. 
NCIM is known for its adaptive approach, customer intimacy and personal touch in augmenting client teams. NCIM emphasizes the importance of long-term relationships and invests as much time as necessary to bolster these relationships. The company is known for reliability and a good price to quality ratio. NCIM currently holds a ISO 9001 and 27001 certificates and is currently recertifing its ISO 14001 certificate.
NCIM provides solutions in various Defence and Public Safety areas, ranging from NATO, the Dutch Army, the Dutch Airforce, Europol, the Supreme Court of Justice, the Dutch Parliament, to the Netherlands Forensic Institute and the Dutch security services AIVD and MIVD (the General Intelligence and Security Service and the Military Intelligence and Security Service).
Apart from the Defence and Public Security domain NCIM has built up a strong name and reputation in commercial organizations like the Dutch Chamber of Commerce, ING Bank, ABN Amro and the Dutch Rail Road Organization.
NCIM is a member of AFCEA ( Armed Forces Communications and Electronics Associations), the NAG (Netherlands Aerospace Group) and NIDV (Stichting Nederlandse Industrie voor Defensie en Veligheid), the Dutch Defence and Security-related Industry Association.

entityDescription:
The activities of the Institute of Physics of Materials of the Czech Academy of Sciences (IPM) are focused on the investigations of relationships between the behaviour and properties of materials and their structural and microstructural characteristics. The priority is the research of advanced metal-based materials, ceramics and composites in relation to their microstructure and the method of preparation. The aim of research activities is the optimisation of functional properties of materials and reliable prediction of their operational lifetime.
The Institute has a long-term focus on the field of materials research, reaching back to 1955 when it was founded with the aim of studying properties of metallic materials. Through natural development, the research portfolio has extended also to other materials suitable for highly sophisticated engineering applications.
At present, great attention is paid, for example, to materials for safe and environmentally friendly generation of electrical energy, new generation of high-strength steels used in automotive and aviation industries, nano-materials with unique properties, high-temperature superalloys used in turbines, materials for implants, functional materials, ceramic materials and composites. The range of expert activities also responds to current trends in the field of materials engineering. A part of research capacities is devoted to the investigation of properties of metallic materials and components produced by the method of 3D printing.

VACOM Vakuum Komponenten & Messtechnik GmbH (VACOM) was founded in 1992. The headquarters is in Großlöbichau. Secondary locations are in Jena, Antwerpen (Belgium) and Naples (Florida, USA). Approximately 10% of the employees are apprentices and 10% are assigned to the R&D department consisting of mechanical and electrical engineers as well as physicists, mechanics, project managers, and laboratory technicians.
VACOM is currently one of the largest vacuum suppliers and manufacturers in Europe. The product portfolio includes measurement equipment (e.g. pressure gauges and residual gas spectrometer), different types of interfaces between atmosphere and vacuum (e.g. optical interfaces like optical fiber feedthroughs or viewports as well as mechanical feedthroughs and electrical feedthroughs), ion getter pumps and all kind of standard and customized vacuum components (e.g. vacuum chambers and connector parts). An essential part of the products is self-developed and self-made at the headquarter in Germany. In addition, VACOM is world leader in cleaning service of vacuum components. The service consists of the development of cleaning strategies and processes of own and customer vacuum components as well as the specification and warranty according to the company’s own purity and vacuum classes. The cleaning service also takes place at the headquarter in Germany.

entityDescription: MYWAI S.r.l. is an innovative Italian startup that has developed on proprietary technology (UIB patent nr 102018000005044 granted on 24/08/2020) different solutions that combine Artificial Intelligence, Internet of Things and Blockchain on distributed Edge networks and Cloud computing for professional, industrial, biomedical and smart cities customers and markets. At the end of 2021 MYWAI S.r.l. acquired by incorporation Zenatek S.p.A., a historic brand of IoT system integration in the professional field in Italy, inheriting as customers some of the most well-known and innovative Italian industrial and biomedical companies on the market (e.g. Fincantieri, Almaviva, ESAOTE, MITSUBISHI Electric, etc.) as well as acquiring significant funding for important research projects in the context of various EU (e.g. Trinity Robotics, IoT 4 Industry, IntellIIoT, etc.) and National (PromenAIde™ project, for the prognostic maintenance of biomedical machinery using neuromorphic chips and AI algorithms on edge) initiatives developed in the new research center opened by MYWAI S.r.l. in the prestigious context of the Bay of Silence in Sestri Levante, Eastern Riviera Ligure between Portofino and Cinqueterre, where it is catalyzing the skills of numerous national and international researchers.The MYWAI™ Technology, developed based on the previously mentioned patent, contains a method and a solution to integrate artificial intelligence on Edge and Very Edge devices by certifying their data and algorithms with next-generation DLT networks. In particular, MYWAI™ technology supports the evolution of critical infrastructures and equipment in the industrial, biomedical and smart cities sectors towards the Equipment and Infrastructure as a Service (EIaaS) model, thanks to the integration of sensors and boards for neuro-computing on edge to enable innovative services in the field of technical assistance (e.g. preventive/predictive maintenance), Fintech (e.g. Pay-per-Use services, Pay-per-Outcome, NFT payments and Smart Contracts) and/or Insurtech (e.g. warranty extension, parametric insurance).MYWAI™ technology supports the collection of field data (e.g. sensors, storage systems, other IT systems already in the field), visualization on GUI, processing and analysis (labeling, creation of descriptive models) and the execution of AI algorithms - in real-time or on historical data - for the recognition of behavioural patterns, prognostics on devices, the search for malfunctions, etc. Depending on the output of the algorithms, it is possible to activate alarms and/or programmed actions (e.g. alerts, device control, test routines). In addition, the possibility of certifying the validity and immutability of data and processing results by publication on DLT/Blockchain is supported.MYWAI S.r.l. supports national and international market and RD initiatives in identifying areas for the development of innovative products and equipment and then proceed to the complete development of the project up to the executive implementation, through the integration of ICT and OT management consulting skills, integrating Knowledge, Experience and Method in a mix of high professional level. Basing its operational approach on the principles of partnership and collaboration with customers as a distinctive characterization, MYWAI S.r.l. offers ICT and OT services as a complement to and complement its MYWAI™ technology.
